title: Complete silence — no game audio
backstory: Sound worked yesterday. Today: nothing. The game runs normally and the POKEY chip produces signals on the board, but the speaker is dead.
visible_effect: WebAudio output gain drops to zero; test tone is silent; audio-meta shows 'fault: dead_amp'
diagnosis_hint: No audio downstream of POKEY usually means the LM380 audio amplifier has failed. Probe the output pin (pin 8) of U10 with a scope — you should see the POKEY signal amplified. No output means the LM380 is dead. Check +12 V supply to pin 14 first.
